instruction: Where did my slide navigation panel go? Please bring it back on the left side.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires bringing back the slide navigation panel on the left. The evaluator checks for 'Slides View' in the accessibility tree.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if the slide navigation panel is present
Getter (accessibility_tree) can capture UI panel state without needing postconfig
Metric logic correctly searches for 'Slides View' in document-frame elements of the accessibility tree
Expected value 'Slides View' is semantically correct - this is the actual name of LibreOffice Impress's slide navigation panel
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (restore navigation panel), evaluator checks exactly that
Parameter handling is correct: metric accesses expected.get('navigation_panel') which properly handles type='rule'
Robust error handling: metric gracefully handles parsing exceptions
Binary scoring (1.0/0.0) is appropriate for presence/absence verification
